clue.text: In a hurry to go after firm in financial difficulties

indicators.note: the hurry piece is placed after the firm piece

parts.note: firm means hard, solid
someone in a hurry is pressed for time

explanation.surface: Someone rushing off to follow a company that has hit money trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: Being short of money leaves a person under heavy strain, the idiom for which is being hard up and squeezed.

clue.text: Arrogance of Mann shunning human nature perversely

indicators.note: shunning means the letters of the name Mann are kept out of the remaining pool
perversely signals that the leftover letters of the phrase are set in a contrary order

explanation.surface: A literary jab at the novelist Thomas Mann, whose arrogance supposedly made him avoid human nature.
explanation.walkthrough: Take MANN out of HUMAN NATURE, leaving HUATURE, which 'perversely' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: lofty pride and disdainful superiority, borrowed from French for loftiness.

clue.text: More than one spoke in ring

definitions.text: More than one spoke in ring

parts.words: More than one spoke in ring
parts.note: the spokes of a wheel run from hub to rim, each one a radius of the circle, so several are the plural

explanation.surface: It sounds like several people talking inside a boxing ring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spoke' looks like the past tense of speak; it is the wheel part, and 'ring' is the wheel's circle.
explanation.definitionFit: Lines from the centre of a circle to its edge, like wheel spokes, are its radiuses, given the Latin plural.

clue.text: Soldier on hill is of the greatest importance

indicators.note: in a down clue, the soldier piece sits on top of the hill piece

parts.note: a para is a paratrooper
a mount is a hill or mountain

explanation.surface: A soldier posted on a hilltop is a matter of the highest importance.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: supreme, foremost, ranking above all others.

clue.text: No good in vaudeville

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the letters of the word vaudeville

explanation.surface: A grumble that nothing in a music-hall variety show is any good.
explanation.definitionFit: Wickedness is the opposite of goodness, so something wicked is no good at all.

clue.text: Cutting losses at last, prior to trial

indicators.note: prior to puts the letter before the trial piece
at last picks the final letter of the word losses

parts.note: a court hearing is a trial

explanation.surface: A firm cutting its losses at the last minute before a court case.
explanation.definitionFit: Clipping wool or metal with shears is cutting it.

clue.text: Old-fashioned parent eats these without stuffing

indicators.note: eats means the parent piece takes the other piece inside it

parts.note: dad is a parent

indicators.note: without stuffing means the word these loses its middle, keeping only its outside letters

explanation.surface: A fusty father who eats his dates plain, without any stuffing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'these' looks like it means dates; it gives TE once its middle is removed, and DAD takes TE in.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: something out of date belongs to a past era, no longer in style.

clue.text: Award for old crossword compiler, right to rise to the top

indicators.note: in a down clue, the right letter climbs from the bottom of the word to its head

parts.note: a setter compiles crosswords

explanation.surface: A prize for a veteran puzzle maker, with the right man rising to the top.
explanation.walkthrough: O plus SETTER gives OSETTER; moving its final R to the front gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A rosette is a ribbon badge awarded as a prize at shows and competitions.

clue.text: 'Carte blanche' should be written this way?

definitions.text: 'Carte blanche' should be written this way?

parts.words: 'Carte blanche' should be written this way?
parts.note: carte blanche means a ..., so the phrase should be drawn or written without guides, in the unaided style

explanation.surface: A pedantic question about how a French phrase should be printed.
explanation.walkthrough: The joke is that carte blanche means a free hand, and drawing unaided by rulers is also called that.
explanation.definitionFit: Drawing or writing done by hand without instruments is said to be done this way, matching carte blanche's meaning of full liberty.

clue.text: Stress needing Junior to queue

parts.note: a junior is under someone, lower in rank
a queue is a line of people

explanation.surface: A young employee stressed by having to wait in a queue.
explanation.definitionFit: To emphasise a point is to stress it, as drawing a rule beneath words does.

clue.text: Names conditions

definitions.meaning: to name things is to call them by words
the conditions of a contract are its stipulations

explanation.surface: A negotiator setting out the names and conditions of a deal.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means calls or describes; as a noun it means the stipulations of an agreement.

clue.text: Puzzle that's new in processing image

indicators.note: in places the new letter inside the rearranged picture
processing a photograph works its contents over, signalling the letters of image are rearranged

explanation.surface: A puzzle about what is new in a picture being processed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'processing' rearranges IMAGE into EIGMA, and N goes in to make the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: a mystery or riddle that is hard to understand.

clue.text: Bank subsidy about to disappear

indicators.note: about means the subsidy piece wraps around the other

parts.note: a grant is a subsidy
to die away is to disappear

explanation.surface: A bank whose subsidy is about to vanish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bank' looks financial, chiming with subsidy, but it means a slope.
explanation.definitionFit: A bank is a slope, and a slope's steepness or incline is measured as this.

clue.text: Scratch session after game

indicators.note: after places the session piece behind the game piece

parts.note: RU stands for rugby union
a bout is a session of activity

explanation.surface: A training session cancelled after a match.
explanation.definitionFit: To scratch something from a list is to remove or erase it.

clue.text: Growth of problem with river flowing north

parts.note: a bind is a problem or nuisance

indicators.note: in a down clue, flowing north means the river's name runs upwards, backwards

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain

explanation.surface: A problem growth along a river that runs northwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A climbing weed that winds around other plants is a kind of growth, here meaning a plant.

clue.text: Cruel but popular chap put in shade

parts.note: in means fashionable, popular

indicators.note: put in places the chap piece inside the shade piece

parts.note: a hue is a shade of colour
a chap is a man

explanation.surface: A popular fellow cruelly cast into the shadows.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: lacking compassion, brutal, without kindness.

clue.text: Out of bed, scenery becomes disturbing

parts.note: someone out of bed is up
a stage setting is its scenery

explanation.surface: Getting up to find the scenery changed is disturbing.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: troubling or distressing.

clue.text: My quiet test for a member of the armed services

parts.note: cor is a British exclamation of surprise, like my!
P is piano, quiet in music
an oral is a spoken test

explanation.surface: An exclamation at a quiet exam set for a soldier.
explanation.walkthrough: COR is a British exclamation of surprise, so 'My!' gives it.
explanation.definitionFit: A corporal is a non-commissioned officer rank in the army.

clue.text: Party people's contribution

parts.note: a do is a party
a nation is a people

explanation.surface: A political party asks for the people's contribution.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: a gift made to a cause or charity.

clue.text: Case of delicate fruity drink providing the final contest

indicators.note: the case of a word is its outside letters, here those of delicate

parts.note: cider is a fruity drink made from apples

explanation.surface: A delicate case of cider settling the last match.
explanation.definitionFit: A deciding game played to break a tie is the final contest.

clue.text: Comments overheard when accommodating team?

indicators.note: accommodating means the when piece holds the team piece inside it

parts.note: as means when, as in as I left
a side is a team

explanation.surface: Remarks you might overhear when putting a team up for the night.
explanation.definitionFit: Remarks spoken apart, as on stage to the audience, are meant to be overheard.

clue.text: Manual dexterity of son with learner crew

parts.note: L is the learner driver's plate
a rowing eight is a crew

explanation.surface: A son nimble with his hands, rowing with a novice crew.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleight of hand is skilful handwork, the deftness of a conjuror.

clue.text: Wife after company loses footing getting flowers

indicators.note: after puts the wife letter behind the company letters

parts.note: one who loses footing slips

explanation.surface: A wife follows guests, stumbles, and comes away with flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: These are yellow spring wild plants of meadows, a kind of primula.

clue.text: Lull, with lease finishing

parts.note: to let a flat is to lease it
up means over or finished, as in time's up

explanation.surface: A quiet spell as a property lease comes to its end.
explanation.definitionFit: A pause or slackening in activity is a lull.

clue.text: Billions invested in tired horses

definitions.note: plural noun; it defines a collective noun for a set of racehorses

indicators.note: invested in places the billions letter inside the tired piece

parts.note: stale means tired, jaded

explanation.surface: A fortune sunk into worn-out racehorses.
explanation.definitionFit: The racehorses kept by one trainer are collectively known by this word, after their stalls.

clue.text: Mainly lacking vision, one dish from Russia

indicators.note: mainly means most of a word, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: someone lacking vision is blind
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A mostly blind man finding a Russian dish.
explanation.definitionFit: These are small buckwheat pancakes from Russia, often served with sour cream.

clue.text: Fish expert suppressed by Germany

indicators.note: in a down clue the expert piece sits beneath the Germany letter

parts.note: D is the international vehicle code for Germany
an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: A fishing expert held down by German rules.
explanation.definitionFit: A small freshwater fish of the carp family.

clue.text: Daughter with scar brooded

parts.note: a welt is a raised scar or weal

explanation.surface: A daughter with a scar sat brooding over it.
explanation.definitionFit: To have dwelt on something is to have brooded about it, lingering in thought.

clue.text: Taking in and converting into cash

definitions.meaning: taking something in means grasping or becoming aware of it

explanation.surface: Someone grasping the situation and selling up for cash.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both understanding a fact and turning property into money.

clue.text: Lost pilot greets one providing a moving experience

indicators.note: a lost pilot is all over the place, signalling the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A disorientated pilot welcomes someone who gives him an emotional experience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving experience' sounds emotional; the spirit literally moves objects.
explanation.definitionFit: A noisy ghost known for throwing objects about, so it literally moves things.
